definition: a senior army officer below a general
description: At an old-style army camp in a flooded field in pouring rain, a senior officer in a peaked cap with a red band, gold badges on his shoulders and a long dark greatcoat stands on the bonnet of a muddy vintage car, pointing with both arms and shouting orders. Soldiers in round helmets pull on the ropes of a sagging tent, papers blow away, a saddled horse runs loose and a brass band plays behind. A dog splashes through the water with a second officer's cap in its mouth.
